SECTION 1. INCORPORATED DOCUMENTS

1.1 The following documents are incorporated into this Agreement by reference and have the same force and effect as if fully set forth herein:

     (a) The Ellsworth Foundation Grantee Handbook, as amended from time to time;
     (b) 2 CFR Part 200, Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards, to the extent made applicable by Section 4.2;
     (c) Exhibit A, Scope of Work and Logic Model;
     (d) Exhibit B, Approved Budget and Budget Narrative;
     (e) Exhibit C, Performance Measurement Framework and Data Dictionary;
     (f) The Foundation's Communications and Attribution Policy, current edition;
     (g) The Foundation's Uniform Data Standards Manual, Version 4.2 or successor version;
     (h) Attachment 1, Insurance and Risk Management Requirements; and
     (i) The Grantee's proposal dated April 14, 2026, as modified by the Foundation's award letter.

1.2 The Grantee acknowledges that it has received or has been given electronic access to each document listed in Section 1.1 and that it is responsible for obtaining the current version of any document described as amended from time to time.

1.3 Order of Precedence. In the event of an inconsistency, the following order controls: this Agreement; Exhibit B; Exhibit A; Exhibit C; the Grantee Handbook; the Foundation's other policies; the Grantee's proposal.

SECTION 2. USE OF FUNDS

2.1 The Grantee shall use the award solely to carry out the activities described in Exhibit A, Scope of Work and Logic Model, and in accordance with the budget set forth in the attached Exhibit B.

2.2 Allowability of costs shall be determined in accordance with the cost principles at 2 CFR Part 200, Subpart E, as adopted by the Foundation in Chapter 6 of the Grantee Handbook. Costs identified as unallowable in Chapter 6 of the Grantee Handbook are unallowable under this award whether or not they are unallowable under 2 CFR Part 200.

2.3 Budget revisions shall be governed by the procedures in Chapter 7 of the Grantee Handbook, as amended. The Grantee shall not deviate from the attached Exhibit B except as permitted by that chapter.

The Ellsworth Foundation — Award ELL-2026-GR-0912 — Page 3 of 6

SECTION 3. REPORTING AND DATA

3.1 Semiannual Reports. The Grantee shall submit semiannual reports in the format prescribed by the Grantee Handbook, as amended, due March 31 and September 30 of each year of the Award Period. The first semiannual report is due March 31, 2027.

3.2 Performance Indicators. The Grantee shall report on each indicator specified in Exhibit C, Performance Measurement Framework and Data Dictionary, using the definitions, denominators, and reporting periods stated in that Exhibit. Indicators not defined in this Agreement are defined in Exhibit C.

3.3 Data Standards. All participant-level data submitted to the Foundation shall conform to the Foundation's Uniform Data Standards Manual, Version 4.2 or successor version, including its requirements for de-identification, field formats, and secure transmission.

3.4 Final Report. A final report meeting the requirements of Chapter 9 of the Grantee Handbook shall be submitted no later than November 29, 2028.

3.5 Audit. The Grantee shall submit its audited financial statements within nine (9) months of the close of each of its fiscal years during the Award Period. If the Grantee is subject to a single audit under 2 CFR Part 200, Subpart F, it shall also submit the complete reporting package including the schedule of findings and questioned costs.

SECTION 4. COMPLIANCE

4.1 The Grantee shall comply with the Foundation's Grantee Handbook, as amended, in all respects. Amendments to the Grantee Handbook take effect ninety (90) days after the Foundation posts them to its grantee portal and apply to this award prospectively.

4.2 Because a portion of the funds supporting this award is derived from a federal source passed through to the Foundation, the Grantee shall comply with 2 CFR Part 200 as if the Grantee were a subrecipient, including the procurement standards at 2 CFR 200.318 through 200.327 and the record retention requirements at 2 CFR 200.334.

4.3 The Grantee shall maintain the insurance coverages described in Attachment 1, Insurance and Risk Management Requirements, and shall furnish certificates of insurance as required by that Attachment.

4.4 The Grantee shall follow the Foundation's Communications and Attribution Policy in all public references to this award, including required language, logo usage, and embargo practices set out in that policy.

SECTION 5. SUBAWARDS AND PROCUREMENT

5.1 The Grantee may issue subawards only to entities approved in Exhibit A and only under written agreements that flow down the requirements of this Agreement, the Grantee Handbook, and 2 CFR Part 200 to the same extent they apply to the Grantee.

5.2 The Grantee shall monitor each subrecipient in accordance with Chapter 11 of the Grantee Handbook and shall document that monitoring in the manner prescribed by that chapter.

5.3 Procurement of goods and services shall follow the standards referenced in Section 4.2 and the additional thresholds stated in Chapter 8 of the Grantee Handbook.

SECTION 6. RECORDS

6.1 The Grantee shall retain records in accordance with 2 CFR 200.334 and Chapter 12 of the Grantee Handbook, whichever requires the longer retention period.

6.2 The Foundation, its auditors, and any federal awarding agency whose funds support this award shall have access to the Grantee's records on the terms stated in the Grantee Handbook.

SECTION 7. MODIFICATION, SUSPENSION, AND TERMINATION

7.1 This Agreement may be modified only in writing signed by both parties, except that the Foundation may unilaterally update the incorporated policies described in Section 1.1(a), (f), and (g) in accordance with Section 4.1.

7.2 The Foundation may suspend or terminate this award for the reasons and by the procedures stated in Chapter 14 of the Grantee Handbook.

7.3 Closeout shall proceed as described in Chapter 15 of the Grantee Handbook.

SECTION 8. REPRESENTATIONS

8.1 The Grantee represents that it is an organization described in Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, that it is in good standing in the State of Missouri, and that the certifications submitted with its proposal remain accurate.

8.2 The Grantee shall notify the Foundation within ten (10) business days if any representation in Section 8.1 ceases to be accurate.
